replacements.Contaminación de benchmarks: cuando el e: Benchmark contamination: when the test has already been seen
replacements.Las imágenes de evaluación aparecen en l: Evaluation images appear in the pretraining data. The score reflects memorization, not real generalization capability.
replacements.Por qué es más grave en multimodalidad: Why it is more serious in multimodality
replacements.Los modelos fundacionales se preentrenan: Foundation models are pretrained on massive amounts of internet data. There is no guarantee that the image-description pairs used for evaluation did not appear in those data. If the model has already seen the benchmark images during training, the score does not measure generalization.
replacements.fotografías públicas con etiquetas · dat: public photographs with labels · published datasets · image-text pairs
replacements.no refleja capacidad real de generalizac: does not reflect real generalization capability
replacements.Sin análisis de contaminación, los resul: Without contamination analysis, published results are an upper bound on the model's real capability on that benchmark, not a direct measurement.
replacements.La contaminación en texto ya es un probl: Text contamination is already a documented problem. In multimodality the problem is structurally larger: benchmark images are often public photographs that may have appeared in pretraining together with their descriptions, labels and surrounding textual context.
replacements.Respuestas correctas del benchmark apare: Correct benchmark answers appear in training data
replacements.El modelo recita respuestas cuando se le: The model recites answers when given the problem ID
replacements.Búsqueda de cadenas de texto en los dato: Search for text strings in the training data
replacements.La imagen completa + su caption + texto: The full image + its caption + surrounding text may be in pretraining
replacements.Los benchmarks de imágenes usan frecuent: Image benchmarks often use public photographs that existed before the model
replacements.Búsqueda de imágenes similares (perceptu: Search for similar images (perceptual hash) in training data — more expensive
replacements.Los benchmarks más antiguos son los más: Older benchmarks are more suspect: more time available on the internet means a greater chance that their images are in the pretraining data of current models. Results are more reliable when the benchmark is newer and better protected from indexing.
replacements.Los laboratorios más rigurosos realizan: The most rigorous labs run contamination analyses before publishing results. Without this analysis, the results are an upper bound on real capability, not a direct measurement.
replacements.Calcular hashes perceptuales de las imág: Compute perceptual hashes for benchmark images and search for matches in the pretraining data. Exact identity is not required: near-identical images already constitute contamination.
replacements.Las imágenes con coincidencias en los da: Images with matches in the training data are excluded from the result analysis. Published results report what percentage of the benchmark was excluded for this reason.
replacements.La solución más robusta es usar benchmar: The most robust solution is to use benchmarks created from data that did not exist on the internet when the model was pretrained, or that are protected from public indexing.
replacements.El escepticismo sobre los resultados deb: Skepticism about results should increase as the benchmark gets older, the model's pretraining becomes larger, and the benchmark images were more publicly accessible at training time.
